stories.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
stories.abstract: Ransomware syndicates Qilin and INC are actively leveraging a previously disclosed authentication bypass vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks' PAN-OS and Prisma Access. The flaw permits unauthorized VPN access, effectively circumventing multi-factor authentication protocols.
stories.why: Active exploitation by ransomware groups indicates this vulnerability is a high-priority target for initial network access and lateral movement.
stories.action: Ensure all PAN-OS and Prisma Access instances are updated to the latest patched versions.

stories.title: ClickFix Attackers Exploit Siemens Software Center Flaw to Deploy Remote Access Trojan
Palo Alto's firewall OS has been under attack from multiple ransomware groups since June
stories.abstract: Palo Alto Networks reports that multiple ransomware actors have been actively exploiting vulnerabilities in PAN-OS to compromise corporate networks since June. Unit 42 researchers observed these campaigns targeting various industry sectors to gain unauthorized access and deploy malicious payloads.
stories.why: Active exploitation of edge infrastructure by ransomware groups poses a critical risk to network perimeter integrity and data confidentiality.
stories.action: Review PAN-OS logs for unauthorized access and apply all available security patches immediately.

stories.title: Redis security advisory (AV26-423) - Update 1
Possible new Cellebrite iPhone Radio Zero-Day
stories.abstract: Leaked documents suggest Cellebrite is developing a new tool capable of bypassing iPhone security features, including Stolen Device Protection. The technology reportedly functions over a distance of eight meters, potentially exploiting vulnerabilities in the device's radio or wireless communication stack.
stories.why: This indicates a potential remote exploit capability against modern iOS security protections, bypassing physical access requirements previously necessary for forensic extraction.

stories.title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
Moxa AIG-302 ThingsPro Edge
stories.abstract: Moxa AIG-302 ThingsPro Edge firmware versions 1.4.0 and earlier contain two vulnerabilities involving missing authorization and hard-coded cryptographic keys. These flaws could allow an authenticated attacker on an adjacent network to access and expose sensitive information from the industrial computing device.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities impact critical infrastructure sectors, potentially allowing unauthorized access to sensitive system data via industrial API endpoints.
stories.action: Update Moxa AIG-302 ThingsPro Edge firmware to a version beyond 1.4.0.

stories.title: HMS Networks PEAK-System PCAN Windows drivers
stories.abstract: Multiple vulnerabilities in HMS Networks PEAK-System PCAN drivers for Windows, including buffer overflows and out-of-bounds write flaws, could allow attackers to trigger kernel crashes. These issues affect driver versions 5.1.2.1151 and earlier.
stories.why: Kernel-level vulnerabilities in industrial hardware drivers pose significant risks to system stability and potential escalation paths for attackers in critical infrastructure environments.
stories.action: Update PEAK-System PCAN Windows drivers to a version newer than 5.1.2.1151.

stories.title: Bullhorn sees red after cyberattack knocks recruitment platform offline
stories.abstract: Staffing software provider Bullhorn has taken its platform offline following a cyberattack. The company is currently working with CrowdStrike to investigate the incident and contain the breach, leaving customers unable to access their recruitment systems while the extent of potential data exposure remains unclear.
stories.why: Supply chain disruptions in recruitment software can lead to significant operational downtime and potential exposure of sensitive candidate and corporate data.

stories.title: [Control systems] GeoVision security advisory (AV26-1066)
Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
stories.abstract: Nikkei Inc. reported a significant data breach involving the exposure of 1.83 million personal records. The stolen information includes names, contact details, and birth dates, marking the organization's third security incident within the past month.
stories.why: Repeated security failures within a short timeframe suggest systemic vulnerabilities in the organization's data protection infrastructure and incident response capabilities.

stories.title: Ahold Delhaize: Cyberattack affects services across US and Europe
stories.abstract: Retail giant Ahold Delhaize is recovering from a recent cyberattack that impacted its digital infrastructure and e-commerce platforms across Europe and the United States. The company is currently working to bring its affected websites and mobile applications back online.
stories.why: Large-scale retail disruptions often indicate ransomware or supply chain compromises that can impact regional food supply logistics and consumer data privacy.

stories.title: Critical FortiSIEM Flaw Gets Public Exploit PoC for Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
stories.abstract: A proof-of-concept exploit is now available for CVE-2026-106173, a critical path traversal vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM. The flaw permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems, posing a significant risk to organizations running unpatched versions of the software.
stories.why: Publicly available exploit code significantly lowers the barrier for attackers to compromise vulnerable FortiSIEM instances, increasing the likelihood of active exploitation.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches provided by Fortinet for FortiSIEM immediately.

stories.title: Hitachi Energy RTU500 Product
Popular WordPress SEO Plugin Rank Math PRO Hijacked to Deliver Self-Restoring Backdoor
WAGO OS Linux
stories.abstract: WAGO has disclosed two vulnerabilities in the web-based management interface of several controller models running WAGO OS Linux. Authenticated users with low privileges can exploit these flaws to bypass authorization controls and manipulate routing or PROFIBUS configuration settings.
stories.why: Privilege escalation in industrial controllers allows unauthorized actors to modify critical network and fieldbus configurations, potentially disrupting operational technology processes.
stories.action: Update WAGO firmware to version 4.10.0 or later.

stories.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
IBM security advisory (AV26-1064)
stories.abstract: IBM has identified security vulnerabilities affecting several enterprise products, including IBM Concert, IBM MQ container images and operators, IBM Sterling Connect:Direct for Unix, and various versions of the IBM i operating system.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities could allow unauthorized access, system compromise, or service disruption across critical infrastructure and middleware components.
stories.action: Review IBM security advisories and apply available patches for the listed products immediately.

stories.title: Russian APT28 Breaches NATO Naval Shipbuilder in NATO Country, Deploys New Reflective Loader
stories.abstract: Russian state-sponsored group APT28, also known as Fancy Bear, successfully compromised a NATO-affiliated naval shipbuilder. The attackers utilized a novel reflective loader and a custom backdoor dubbed HOOKEDGE to maintain persistence and facilitate espionage within the targeted member states.
stories.why: This represents a targeted intelligence-gathering operation against critical defense infrastructure by a sophisticated adversary with high-level strategic objectives.

stories.title: 'Password1' and a forgotten test account land Welsh outfits in hot water
China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
stories.abstract: The China-linked threat actor Armory Castle exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support, formerly known as Bomgar. The flaw, CVE-2026-102764, involves improper origin validation within an internal messaging component, allowing unauthorized access to the affected systems.
stories.why: Edge devices remain a primary target for state-sponsored espionage groups seeking initial access to sensitive enterprise networks.
stories.action: Apply the vendor-provided security patch for BeyondTrust Remote Support immediately.

stories.title: WhatsApp Hid Instructions in Help Pages Telling Its AI Chatbot Not to Recommend Privacy Regulators
Hacked? #cybersecurity #Infosec #technews
stories.abstract: The provided source material consists of promotional podcast content and event announcements. It lacks specific details regarding a security incident, vulnerability, or actionable threat intelligence.

stories.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
stories.abstract: A critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-99999, allows attackers to escape a Linux KVM virtual machine and access host memory. The flaw resides within the kernel's networking subsystem, potentially impacting shared cloud environments and multi-tenant infrastructure.
stories.why: VM escapes undermine the fundamental isolation boundaries required for secure cloud computing and multi-tenant workload separation.
stories.action: Monitor Linux distribution security advisories and apply kernel patches immediately upon release.

stories.title: Defense contractors in two NATO allies hacked in recent Russia-linked campaign
stories.abstract: Russian state-sponsored threat actor APT28 successfully compromised the networks of two NATO-aligned defense contractors and a law enforcement organization. The attackers utilized a previously identified backdoor to maintain persistent access within these sensitive environments.
stories.why: This indicates a targeted intelligence-gathering campaign against critical defense infrastructure within the NATO alliance.

stories.title: Hackers Abuse AI Pen-Test Tool Cairn to Automate Massive Attack Spree
AOMEI Backupper Compromised in Short-Burst Supply Chain Campaign
Introducing a new AI chapter in the NCSC research problem book
stories.abstract: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre has expanded its research problem book to include a dedicated section on artificial intelligence, highlighting emerging challenges and technical questions regarding the intersection of machine learning and defensive security operations.
stories.why: It identifies the specific technical research gaps and security priorities the UK government is focusing on regarding AI integration and risk management.

stories.title: DeepSeek deep-sixed at all US federal civilian agencies
Hackers hijack AOMEI update servers to secretly spread malware
stories.abstract: Attackers breached AOMEI's infrastructure to inject malicious payloads into the company's backup software. By manipulating internal configuration files used for promotional updates, the threat actors successfully distributed malware to users before reverting the changes to conceal their unauthorized activity.
stories.why: Supply chain compromises via legitimate update mechanisms bypass traditional perimeter defenses, turning trusted software into a vehicle for malware delivery.

stories.title: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1061)
stories.abstract: Red Hat has issued a broad security advisory covering a wide range of its enterprise software portfolio, including RHEL, OpenShift, Ansible, and OpenStack. The notification indicates that multiple versions of these products are currently impacted by various security vulnerabilities.
stories.why: System administrators must audit their Red Hat infrastructure to identify and mitigate potential exposures across these core enterprise platforms.
stories.action: Review the Red Hat security portal for specific CVE details and apply relevant product updates.

stories.title: Ivanti security advisory (AV26-1035) - Update 1
Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
stories.abstract: Federal investigators have linked executives at ransomware negotiation firms to the ShinyHunters hacking group. Evidence suggests these individuals maintained improper ties with the threat actors, with one U.S.-based executive allegedly assisting in the operation of a site used to extort data breach victims.
stories.why: This reveals a significant conflict of interest and potential criminal complicity within the professional ransomware negotiation industry, complicating incident response trust.

stories.title: GhostAction Attackers Plant Credential Stealer Disguised as Font in 94 GitHub Repositories
stories.abstract: Threat actors known as GhostAction are targeting GitHub repositories by embedding credential-stealing malware within deceptive font files. This campaign represents an evolution in their tactics, moving beyond malicious workflow injections to actively compromise open-source projects and harvest developer credentials.
stories.why: This indicates a sophisticated supply chain threat targeting developer environments and CI/CD pipelines to facilitate credential theft and potential downstream code poisoning.

stories.title: 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach
Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
stories.abstract: A threat actor utilized autonomous AI agents to scan and compromise over 100 corporate websites. The campaign, which targeted more than 1,200 domains, was discovered after the attackers inadvertently exposed their command-and-control infrastructure to the public internet.
stories.why: This demonstrates the practical application of autonomous agents in scaling web exploitation and credential harvesting, lowering the barrier for automated mass-scale attacks.

stories.title: CJIS v6.1 Compliance: 5 Practical Priorities for Agencies
stories.abstract: Law enforcement agencies must align with the updated CJIS v6.1 security standards. Compliance mandates focus on strengthening multi-factor authentication, refining account lifecycle management, enforcing robust password policies, and maintaining comprehensive audit logs to ensure data integrity and regulatory readiness.
stories.why: CJIS compliance is mandatory for agencies handling sensitive criminal justice data; failure to meet these standards risks legal penalties and system access revocation.

stories.title: OnlyFans Copyright Takedowns Expose Compromised Websites
Hacker gets 8 years for stealing $3.3 million from taxpayers
There's only so much code: the rise in vulnerability numbers
Pegasus Spyware Infection Confirmed on Serbian University Rector's iPhone Days Before Election
AOMEI yet to notify customers after hackers hijacked its software updates
Florida DMV hacked after police dept insecurely stored login info
stories.abstract: Florida officials confirmed a data breach affecting the state's motor vehicle department. The incident, attributed to the threat group ShinyHunters, stemmed from compromised credentials that were improperly managed by a local law enforcement agency, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive records.
stories.why: This highlights the critical risk of credential mismanagement and the potential for lateral movement when local agencies interface with centralized state databases.

stories.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
How a Massive Chinese Crime Ring Hacked Staples to Steal Millions
Hackers Exploit Plex2Shell Flaws to Install Crypto Miners and Linux Proxy Backdoor
stories.abstract: Attackers are actively exploiting a four-vulnerability chain dubbed Plex2Shell in Plex Media Server. The exploit allows unauthorized remote code execution, which threat actors are currently using to install cryptocurrency miners and establish persistent Linux-based reverse proxy backdoors on compromised systems.
stories.why: This chain enables full system compromise, turning media servers into nodes for botnets or illicit mining operations.
stories.action: Restrict Plex Media Server access to trusted networks and monitor for unauthorized outbound traffic.

stories.title: Grocery giant Ahold Delhaize confirms cyberattack forced US and European systems offline
People Are Using 'AI Decompiling' to Hack Their Things
stories.abstract: The provided source material is insufficient to describe a specific security event. While it mentions hackers targeting Staples, it lacks context regarding the methods, impact, or the role of AI decompiling in the incident.

stories.title: Hackers Use New ROMULUS ClickFix Platform to Deliver LegionLoader and Other Malware
EU cyber law won’t force fixes for fridge controllers hit in French attack
stories.abstract: The European Union's Cyber Resilience Act mandates that manufacturers provide security updates only for the duration of a product's defined support lifecycle. Consequently, devices like smart appliances remain vulnerable once their official support period expires, regardless of ongoing security risks.
stories.why: Security teams must account for the finite support windows of IoT hardware, as regulatory requirements do not mandate indefinite vulnerability remediation.

stories.title: Nigerian national given 8-year sentence for tax business hacks
Revolut outage disrupts online banking operations worldwide
stories.abstract: Global fintech platform Revolut experienced a widespread service disruption today, rendering most of its banking features inaccessible to users worldwide. The company is currently investigating the root cause and working to restore full operational functionality.
stories.why: Service outages in financial infrastructure can disrupt critical payment processing and expose potential weaknesses in high-availability systems.
